full_primitive_definitions:
def MediumAtom.q1SliceAtom (d : MediumAtom) (p : ℕ) : MediumAtom :=
  { d with gamma1 := fun q ↦ if q = p then 1 else 0 }

def MediumAtom.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ℕ :=
  (factorCarrier d.Q1).filter (fun p ↦ p.Coprime d.residue.natAbs)

def MediumAtom.sharedFirstFactorRows (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) :=
  (factorCarrier d.Q2 ×ˢ factorCarrier d.Q3) ×ˢ d.transposedAtom.betaCarrier

def MediumAtom.sharedPrimitiveUVError (d : MediumAtom) : ℂ :=
  ∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
    (((d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexDispersionU
        d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight : ℂ) -
      primitiveZeroMain (d.q1SliceAtom p)) -
      2 * (((d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexDispersionV
        d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight : ℂ) -
          primitiveZeroMain (d.q1SliceAtom p))

def MediumAtom.complexCRTSmoothNonzeroPart (d : MediumAtom) : ℂ :=
  ∑ l ∈ d.complexRowLabels, ∑ l' ∈ d.complexRowLabels,
    d.complexBetaCoefficient l * star (d.complexBetaCoefficient l') *
      (if ComplexCRT.Compatible (complexFactorModulus l.1)
        (complexFactorModulus l'.1) l.2 l'.2 then
          (∑' h : ℤ, CommonSmoothCutoff.poissonNonzeroFrequency
            (d.U / (complexFactorModulus l.1).lcm (complexFactorModulus l'.1))
            ((ComplexCRT.residue (complexFactorModulus l.1)
              (complexFactorModulus l'.1) l.2 l'.2 d.residue : ℝ) /
                (complexFactorModulus l.1).lcm (complexFactorModulus l'.1)) h).re
      else 0 : ℝ)

def MediumAtom.complexCRTSmoothZeroPart (d : MediumAtom) : ℂ :=
  ∑ l ∈ d.complexRowLabels, ∑ l' ∈ d.complexRowLabels,
    d.complexBetaCoefficient l * star (d.complexBetaCoefficient l') *
      (if ComplexCRT.Compatible (complexFactorModulus l.1)
        (complexFactorModulus l'.1) l.2 l'.2 then
          ((d.U / (complexFactorModulus l.1).lcm (complexFactorModulus l'.1)) *
            CommonSmoothCutoff.cutoffMass : ℝ) else 0)

def MediumAtom.commonSmoothCarrier (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ℕ :=
  Finset.Icc 0 (Nat.ceil (3 * d.U))

def MediumAtom.commonSmoothWeight (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  CommonSmoothCutoff.scaledDyadicCutoff d.U (n : ℝ)
def scaledDyadicCutoff (M x : ℝ) : ℝ := dyadicCutoff (x / M)

def MediumAtom.transposedAtom (d : MediumAtom) : MediumAtom :=
  { d with
    U := d.V
    V := d.U
    intervalLo := -1
    intervalHi := (Nat.floor (2 * d.V) : ℝ)
    alpha := d.beta
    beta := fun n ↦ if n ∈ d.alphaCarrier then d.alpha n else 0 }
def complexFactorModulus (r : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : ℕ := r.1 * r.2.1 * r.2.2

def MediumAtom.complexFactorGamma (d : MediumAtom) (r : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : ℂ :=
  d.gamma1 r.1 * d.gamma2 r.2.1 * d.gamma3 r.2.2

def MediumAtom.complexFactorLabels (d : MediumAtom) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) :=
  factorCarrier d.Q1 ×ˢ (factorCarrier d.Q2 ×ˢ factorCarrier d.Q3)

def MediumAtom.complexRowLabels (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) :=
  d.complexFactorLabels ×ˢ d.betaCarrier

def MediumAtom.complexProgressionRow (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ l ∈ d.complexRowLabels, d.complexFactorGamma l.1 * d.beta l.2 *
    (if (((n * l.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) % (complexFactorModulus l.1 : ℤ) =
      d.residue % (complexFactorModulus l.1 : ℤ)) then 1 else 0)

def MediumAtom.complexPrincipalRow (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ l ∈ d.complexRowLabels,
    d.complexFactorGamma l.1 * d.beta l.2 *
      (if (n * l.2).Coprime (complexFactorModulus l.1) then 1 else 0) /
        (Nat.totient (complexFactorModulus l.1) : ℂ)

def MediumAtom.complexCenteredRow (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  d.complexProgressionRow n - d.complexPrincipalRow n

def MediumAtom.complexDispersionV (d : MediumAtom) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ S, w n *
    (d.complexProgressionRow n * star (d.complexPrincipalRow n)).re

def Compatible (q r m1 m2 : ℕ) : Prop :=
  m1.Coprime q ∧ m2.Coprime r ∧ Nat.ModEq (q.gcd r) m1 m2

def residue (q r m1 m2 : ℕ) (a : ℤ) : ℤ :=
  if h : Compatible q r m1 m2 then
    Classical.choose (exists_product_crt_residue h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2 a)
  else 0

def MediumAtom.complexBetaCoefficient (d : MediumAtom)
    (l : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) : ℂ := d.complexFactorGamma l.1 * d.beta l.2

def primitiveZeroMain (d : MediumAtom) : ℂ :=
  ((d.V * CommonSmoothCutoff.cutoffMass : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    ∑ a ∈ d.complexFactorLabels, ∑ b ∈ d.complexFactorLabels,
      d.complexFactorGamma a * star (d.complexFactorGamma b) *
        coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier d.alpha (complexFactorModulus a) *
          star (coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier d.alpha (complexFactorModulus b)) *
            (((complexFactorModulus a * complexFactorModulus b).totient : ℂ) /
              (((complexFactorModulus a).totient : ℂ) *
                ((complexFactorModulus b).totient : ℂ) *
                  (complexFactorModulus a * complexFactorModulus b : ℕ)))
def MediumAtom.scale (d : MediumAtom) : ℝ := d.U * d.V

def MediumAtom.betaCarrier (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ℕ :=
  Finset.Icc (Nat.ceil d.V) (Nat.floor (2 * d.V))

def UniformAuxiliarySW {ι : Type*} (F : ι → MediumAtom) (C0 : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ x0 : ℝ, 1 < x0 ∧
    ∀ i : ι, x0 ≤ (F i).scale → ∀ k q b : ℕ,
      1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ q → Nat.Coprime b q →
      ‖(F i).auxSWError k q b‖ ≤
        C * (F i).U * ((k.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ C0) /
          (Real.log (F i).scale) ^ A

def MediumAdmissible (B : ℕ) (σ κ c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ d.U ∧ 1 ≤ d.V ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q1 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q2 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q3 ∧
  Real.exp (Real.exp 1) < d.scale ∧
  c0 * d.scale ≤ (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ≤ d.scale ^ (1 + κ) ∧
  d.Q1 < d.U * d.scale ^ (-σ) ∧
  d.U ^ 2 * d.Q2 * d.Q3 ^ 2 < d.scale ^ (1 - 8 * σ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ^ (7 / 32 : ℝ) * d.U * d.Q1 * d.Q2 ^ 5 * d.Q3 ^ 2 <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  d.U ^ (1 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q1 *
      d.Q2 ^ (5 - 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q3 ^ (2 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, ‖d.alpha n‖ ≤ 1) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, d.alpha n ≠ 0 → ∀ p : ℕ,
    Nat.Prime p → p ∣ n →
      d.scale ^ (1 / (Real.log (Real.log d.scale)) ^ 3) < (p : ℝ)) ∧
  (∀ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ≤ (m.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ B) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1, ‖d.gamma1 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma1 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ‖d.gamma2 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma2 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3, ‖d.gamma3 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma3 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs))

def RestrictedMediumTarget {ι : Type*} (F : ι → MediumAtom) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ x0 : ℝ, 1 < x0 ∧
    ∀ i : ι, x0 ≤ (F i).scale →
      ‖(F i).signedError‖ ≤ C * (F i).scale / (Real.log (F i).scale) ^ A

actual_nonzero_semantics.same_p: N_d is the sum over the full primitive dyadic NATURAL first-factor carrier p.Coprime residue.natAbs. p need not be prime; it is not restricted to nonzero gamma1 support. gamma1 is entirely in the actual outside L2 factor after Cauchy and is not inserted in N_d.
actual_nonzero_semantics.rows: After unfolding point-mass gamma1, each row is ((q2,q3),n) in d.sharedFirstFactorRows, n in d.transposedAtom.betaCarrier=factorCarrier d.U; its coefficient is gamma2(q2)*gamma3(q3)*alphaZeroExtended(n). Both paired rows share exactly the same p, with original complex coefficient times star of the second.
actual_nonzero_semantics.physical_moduli: q=p*(q2*q3), r=p*(q2prime*q3prime); lcm(q,r)=p*lcm(tail,tailprime). The common smoothing is at original V, so t=V/lcm(q,r). This is not the old independent-first-factor lcm or the unsliced nonzero part.
actual_nonzero_semantics.full_units_and_CRT: Compatible(q,r,n,nprime) retains n coprime q, nprime coprime r and n congruent nprime modulo p*gcd(tail,tailprime). The phase uses the actual constructed CRT.residue at the original signed moving residue.
actual_nonzero_semantics.complete_series: Every original integer h is kept. poissonNonzeroFrequency sets h=0 to0; no sign is dropped. The inner full tsum is norm-summable at t>0 by the actual parent theorem. This proposal neither truncates the Fourier series nor claims a tail estimate or swaps an unjustified infinite sum.
actual_nonzero_semantics.location_of_norm: The norm in the main endpoint is after the FULL complex energy-minus-sum_p-NZ. The minimal analytic remainder is Re(sum_p NZ_p). A sufficient stronger bound may use norm(sum_p NZ_p). A sum_p norm(NZ_p) changes the object and can lose the same-p cancellation; no such substitution is licensed.
actual_nonzero_semantics.no_transposed_admissibility: Use original MediumAdmissible for each point-mass q1SliceAtom and the parent transported common-Poisson identity. Do not assert MediumAdmissible for the transposed atom.
